1971 spirit ruined for lack of democracy
2016-03-26T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/news/1971-spirit-ruined-lack-democracy-1199899

The spirit of the Liberation War has been totally ruined as there is no democracy in the country, BNP acting secretary general Mirza Fakhrul Islam said yesterday.

"Today a play is being staged regarding election… and the duty of the Election Commission has been to serve the ruling party," he told a discussion on Independence Day at the Institution of Engineers, Bangladesh in the capital.

Fakhrul also protested the rape and killing of Shohagi Jahan Tonu, a student and cultural activist in Comilla.

"Comilla has raised its voice [demanding punishment for Tonu's killers], and so will Bangladesh. I am urging the women's leaders of the country to protest the incident," he said.

Meanwhile, BNP Chairperson Khaleda Zia yesterday called for building a strong national unity to protect democracy.

In a message issued on the occasion of Independence Day today, she said people fought in the Liberation War to build a country free from exploitation and deprivation, but the goal was not achieved yet.
